source_text:
3.7 Τοῦ αὐτοῦ· εἰς ἀφθονίαν γάλακτοσ
Λίθος ὁ γαλακτίτης τοῦ ζῴου περιαπτόμενος τοῖς μαστοῖς πολύ τι χρῆμα τοῦ
γάλακτος κατασπᾷ. Ἵνα δὲ καὶ πλείονος εὐπορήσῃ γάλακτος, αὐτὸν τὸν γαλακτίτην
λίθον λελειωμένον ἐγχυμάτιζε μετὰ οἴνου καὶ ὕδατος.
pass_a_gloss: 3.7 Of-the-same: into abundance of-milk. Stone the galactites of-the-animal being-hung-around to-the-breasts much some thing of-the-milk draws-down. So-that also of-more it-may-have-plenty of-milk, itself the galactites stone having-been-pounded drench with wine and water.
pass_b_english: Of the same: into abundance of milk. The galactites stone, hung around the breasts of the animal, draws down a great deal of milk. So that it may also have plenty of still more milk, drench with the galactites stone itself, pounded, with wine and water.

choices.term: πολύ τι χρῆμα τοῦ γάλακτος κατασπᾷ
choices.english: draws down a great deal of milk
choices.why: κατασπᾷ is a drawing-down of milk, not 'spoils the milk'.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
